versions.description: Weekly Top Rewards ranks players every week on playtime, kills and currency earned, using data Takaro already records. A cron job (default Sunday 20:00 UTC, change it in the cron job settings) pays the top 3 of each category with currency, optional items and an optional expiring role, broadcasts the winners and can post them to Discord, including a live leaderboard message that keeps updating. Players see live standings with the weeklytop command (add playtime, kills, currency or last). Items for offline winners are delivered at their next login.

commands.name: weeklytop
commands.helpText: Shows this week's top players. Add playtime, kills or currency to see one category, or last to see last week's winners.

arguments.name: category
arguments.helpText: all, playtime, kills, currency or last

hooks.name: deliver-pending
hooks.description: Gives item prizes to winners who were offline when the week closed

cronJobs.name: award-weekly
cronJobs.description: Closes the week, pays the top 3 per category and starts a new week

cronJobs.name: update-discord-leaderboard
cronJobs.description: Edits the live Discord leaderboard message (does nothing unless discordLiveChannelId is set)
